guitar.modelsText: PRS (Paul Reed Smith) / later Tremonti signature models
guitar.notes: Mark Tremonti is well known as a longtime PRS endorser, eventually getting his own PRS Tremonti signature model. Medium confidence since this became iconic mainly post-Creed (Alter Bridge era).

tone.target: thick saturated alt-rock crunch with big sustain
tone.profile: thick saturated alt-rock crunch with big sustain
tone.summary: A saturated, mid-forward signal chain using an OD boost into a classic British amp model (UK 45) for thick alt-rock crunch, finished with delay and room ambience.

rig.name: Creed - With Arms Wide Open - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and stray notes.
Provide compressed drive and mid-forward crunch (Must Have).
blocks.gap: The Green OD is a general overdrive, suitable for the required 'compressed drive' without being too aggressive.

alternatives.reason: A slightly cleaner option if more saturation isn't needed.

blocks.purpose: Add thick saturation and sustain (Must Have).
blocks.gap: Using the general 'Distortion' model to push the signal into a saturated alt-rock tone, complementing the Green OD.

alternatives.reason: Might be too aggressive or mid-scooped for this specific track.

blocks.purpose: Provide the classic Marshall/JCM style tone and mid-forward crunch.

alternatives.reason: Similar, but UK 45 is often preferred for this specific alt-rock voicing.

blocks.purpose: Match the classic British amp voicing and required 4x12 cabinet.
Fine-tune the mid-forward crunch and sustain.
blocks.gap: Using a dedicated EQ to sculpt the tone after the amp/cab stage, focusing on mids for alt-rock punch.

blocks.purpose: Optional subtle thickening (kept off to avoid 'heavy chorus' avoidance).
blocks.gap: Chorus is generally avoided, but a very subtle setting could add width if needed.

blocks.purpose: Provide the required slight ambient delay (Must Have).
Add subtle ambient space and sustain.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR for better saturation and modern alt-rock punch.

proposals.reason: Enhance saturated, modern alt-rock tone and sustain.
